title: TaskPayload
description: A task on `<prefix>.tasks.<domain>.<knight>`. Dispatchers differ in shape (the operator's camelCase TaskPayload, snake_case knight `nats_request` payloads), so both spellings are accepted. A message that is not a JSON object is plain task text and is not checked against this schema.

taskId.description: Unique task ID (operator TaskPayload). The result is published to `<prefix>.results.<taskId>`.

task_id.description: Unique task ID, snake_case spelling (knight `nats_request` payloads). Falls back to the last subject token when neither spelling is set.

chainName.description: Chain name; set for chain steps and mission briefings.

stepName.description: Chain step name; set for chain steps and mission briefings.

runId.description: Chain run ID, or for gateway tasks the conversation ID. Knights key agent sessions on it so context never bleeds between runs. Empty means no run identity.

model.description: Per-task model override, already resolved from RoundTable aliases and checked against the knight's runtime. Applies to this task only; empty means the knight's configured model.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number, set by a manual retry. Absent means attempt 1.

retryOf.description: The task ID this task retries (manual retry).

previousFailure.description: Why the earlier attempt failed or was lost (manual retry; up to 2 KB, longer values are cut).

domain.description: Task domain the dispatcher routed on.

from.description: Knight that sent the task; a knight skips tasks it sent itself.

timestamp.description: When the task was published (RFC 3339). Used for queue time; an unparseable value is ignored.

timeout_ms.description: Per-task timeout in ms. Zero or negative means unset (the knight default applies).
